_why: M1 deep-dive end-state. Object state only, state-tolerant: each check reads objects the page seeds (device-request, sim, a server-side dry run that stores nothing). Run after labs/m1/checks.json from the learner tree: (cd labs && node ../scripts/run-checks.mjs m1/deep-dive.checks.json).

checks.describe: at least one FailedScheduling Event exists for Pod device-request
checks.run: sh -c 'n=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m1-baseline get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=device-request,reason=FailedScheduling -o name | wc -l | tr -d " "); echo "failedscheduling_events=$n"'

checks.describe: a FailedScheduling Event for Pod device-request names the missing device (Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu): the Event keeps its first failure's message, so this fails when the Pod was scheduled against a worker that was not yet Ready
checks.run: sh -c 'KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m1-baseline get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=device-request,reason=FailedScheduling -o jsonpath="{.items[*].message}"; echo'

checks.describe: the EndpointSlice for sim exposes ready, serving and terminating on its first endpoint
checks.run: sh -c 'KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m1-baseline get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=sim -o jsonpath="{range .items[*].endpoints[*]}ready={.conditions.ready} serving={.conditions.serving} terminating={.conditions.terminating}{\"\\n\"}{end}" | head -1'

checks.describe: a server-side dry-run HPA with spec.behavior.scaleUp.tolerance is accepted and echoes the normalised quantity 50m (HPAConfigurableTolerance, GA in 1.37)
checks.run:
sh -c 'printf "apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: sim-tolerance-check
  namespace: m1-baseline
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: sim
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 4
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 50
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      tolerance: "0.05"
" | KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core apply --dry-run=server -f - -o jsonpath="{.spec.behavior.scaleUp}"; echo'
